summary:
UI design document for Bharatiyam Panchanga app with 3 screen mockups:
1. Home Screen - calendar grid with today's panchanga summary
2. Detail Screen - full panchanga view with 4 calendar system tabs
3. Muhurta Screen - timings, lagna transits, hora

Includes design system specification: dark purple theme, gold accents, glassmorphism cards, sacred geometry elements, Indic typography.
